hypothesis.claim: Persistence failures must be distinct from client payload errors and map to one stable catalog-unavailable contract across direct Catalog calls, all component-preset HTTP methods, and indirect architecture reads.
hypothesis.trigger: presets.json is malformed/semantically unreadable, the cache path is a directory, lock acquisition fails, or atomic save/temporary cleanup fails
hypothesis.expected_baseline: GET=500 internal_error, POST=422 scenario_error, PUT/DELETE=400 invalid_component_preset, and direct Catalog calls leak JSON/OSError types
hypothesis.expected_candidate: direct Catalog paths raise ComponentPresetPersistenceError; running HTTP endpoints return 503 catalog_unavailable without local paths; startup fails fast with the stable error type
hypothesis.falsifier: any covered persistence failure reaches a generic endpoint code, leaks a raw path/traceback, or changes valid payload/404/409 semantics

implementation: wrap persisted read, atomic write, lock, and temporary cleanup failures
map the error before generic handlers in GET/POST/PUT/DELETE
keep the HTTP envelope fixed at 503/catalog_unavailable and avoid exception text
activation_checks: baseline matrix reproduced inconsistent 500/422/400 endpoint mapping
candidate matrix maps all five component-preset endpoints to 503/catalog_unavailable
architecture detail indirect component read maps to the same envelope
bad startup persistence raises ComponentPresetPersistenceError and CLI catches it without traceback
valid client validation and CRUD tests remain green
